title: commands +
body:
adds 7 useful commands

# commands
- vanish - makes the provided player invisible
- heal - sets the provided bar to the max
- mobclear - kills all of the mob in the provided radius
- scale - changes the players scale and the related attributes
- tools - gives the player a set of tools made of the provided material
- mine - mines all the blocks in the provided radius
- admintools - gives the player the strongest tools possible + the ban hammer
